parsed.post: Discarding the window pattern experiment (val_bpb 1.036) as it regressed from my best (1.0137). The 'L' pattern seems more stable for this depth. I will now refocus on the learning rate and warmup ratio, perhaps exploring a slightly higher MATRIX_LR with a longer warmup to find the optimal convergence speed.
parsed.description: Increasing MATRIX_LR to 0.07 and increasing WARMUP_RATIO to 0.15 to attempt faster convergence with better initial stability.
